title: Feat/menu select widget
body:
I'm opening this PR to keep track progress of the `menuSelect` widget.

* \[x] displays current refined value
* \[x] update results after new selected refined value
* \[x] rename `RefinementSelect` to `menuSelect` (needs to get some input from the team about naming)
* \[x] tests
* \[x] documentation & examples

**What project are you opening a pull request for?**

* instantsearch.js (use develop base)
